title: Who will score the opening goal when Real Betis host Real Madrid in La Liga in September 2026?
background: The opening goalscorer is the player officially credited with the first goal of the match.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : La Liga's official match record, corroborated by reliable match reporting. 
  Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the player credited with the earliest goal in the September 2026 La Liga fixture hosted by Real Betis against Real Madrid. Disallowed goals do not count. If the match finishes goalless, resolve as “No goalscorer.” 
  Accepted Answer Format : The player's full name.
